targets.note: rc.17: the invite's account step on a device with no account. It says it creates your Vyre account, and offers I already have a Vyre account.
rc.17: the owner claim form with I already have a Vyre account.
I already have a Vyre account: the address of a Space you are in. The account comes with the same password and recovery code.
Sign in to that Space with the username and password; Use your recovery code below.
A Space that signs you in with Google: the username and recovery code bring the account here.
A wrong username or code: one line, the same for both.
After the recovery code: a password chosen once. The recovery code stays the same.
Continue as for a person this device knows from Google: one field takes the password set at joining, or the recovery code. Asked once on this device.
After the recovery code on Continue as: a password chosen once.
Settings > Sign-in > Use one account everywhere: keep the Personal account, prove both.
Done: MLA now signs you in as irfad, with the same password and recovery code; your work there is unchanged.
